overview.description: The ProShares UltraShort Health Care (RXD) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Health Care Select Sector index. The fund provides -2x exposure to a market-cap-weighted index of US health care companies. RXD was launched on Jan 30, 2007 and is issued by ProShares.
